EMITTER (new src/pi/splash/system_status_emitter.py, mirrors the F-103 shutdown_state_emitter seam): buildSystemStatusState (pure A-3 schema -- obdLink{state,retries,lastSeenS}/sync{lastOkTs,rows,pending,stale}/power{mode,source}/drive{state,driveId}/ts) + makeSystemStatusEmitter(statesDir, *, syncStaleThresholdS, nowIsoFn) -> best-effort emit(**live readings) that computes stale + writes atomically (reuses ensureStatesDir/writeStateAtomic; write failure logged-never-raised so the dashboard hook never blocks the orchestrator loop) + isSyncStaleWhileDriving(driveState, lastOkTs, nowIso, *, thresholdS) policy helper. A-3 OWNERSHIP: the orchestrator/sync tier owns the emitter (holds live BT-link + sync_log + DriveDetector state) and CALLS emit(...) -- unidirectional, same as power_watch->shutdown emitter; the emitter never reaches back. HONEST-INSTRUMENT: obdLink.state reported verbatim (linked/reconnecting/down), never fabricated 'linked'; absent/unparseable last-sync while recording -> stale (never claim unprovable freshness). THRESHOLD: syncStaleThresholdS is a REQUIRED factory param (Spool S-3 owns the value, config supplies it) -- NO hardcoded tuning number (Refusal Rule 2 / PM Rule 7). CARD (carousel.js): added pure node-testable render logic exported on `api` -- obdLinkTile/syncTile/powerTile/driveTile (each -> {label,value,detail,level}), btGlyphState/syncGlyphState/powerGlyphState, systemStatusView(data) (non-object -> null). F-1 cardinal rule: a tile/glyph is `ok`(green) ONLY when the underlying state is genuinely good; down/reconnecting/stale/battery -> amber/down/neutral, never green. DOM render (browser-only): renderSystemStatusCard fills the card-body via textContent (verbatim, no innerHTML) + binds the top-bar glyph data-state; resetSystemGlyphs returns glyphs to neutral on unavailable (no lingering stale-green). I-033: reconnecting -> tile RECONNECTING + retries + amber BT glyph, surfaced within the 4Hz poll (<=2s). dashboard.css: .tile + [data-level=ok/amber/down/unavailable] value colours bound to the palette. stories.completionNotes: Pygame sunset SHIPPED -- parity-gated (A-4) now that BOTH carousel cards reached parity (US-400 System Status + US-401 Battery Health). CUT-OVER = `pi.hardware.statusDisplay.enabled` -> false in config.json: with the overlay off, HardwareManager._initializeStatusDisplay returns early and never opens a pygame surface, so the HTML carousel (launched by the splash OnSuccess= hand-off) is the SOLE dashboard surface -- the two are never both active (F-4). status_display.py/dashboard_layout.py stay in the tree (NOT deleted -- acceptance is 'no longer launched', and they remain re-enablable for a bench diagnostic + preserve the US-198 escape hatch + existing tests). LOAD-BEARING BUG FOUND + FIXED (this is why a config flip alone would NOT have worked): createHardwareManagerFromConfig resolved the overlay flag from the FLAT top-level `hardware.statusDisplay.*`, but lifecycle.py passes the FULL config where the canonical flag lives at the NESTED `pi.hardware.statusDisplay.*` (config.json) -- so pre-US-402 the nested flag was SILENTLY IGNORED and the overlay always launched on its True default (verified: lifecycle.py:1341 passes self._config, the factory reads top-level `hardware.*` while config.json has only `pi.hardware.*`; the factory is internally inconsistent -- it already reads `pi.shutdown.poweroffTimeoutSeconds` pi-prefixed). FIX: factory now resolves the nested path FIRST (pi.hardware.statusDisplay.enabled / .forceSoftwareRenderer), falling back to the flat path then legacy hardware.display.enabled -- mirrors the factory's own pi.shutdown pattern; flat fallback preserves the US-198 operator escape hatch. NOT passing config['pi'] to the factory (that would have broken the pi.shutdown.poweroffTimeoutSeconds read -> reverted it to default). SCOPE: DisplayManager (pi.display, headless by default) is a SEPARATE subsystem -- out of scope; US-402 targets exactly the status_display.py/dashboard_layout.py pygame overlay named in the story. Rule-10 (load-bearing surface retirement): specs/architecture.md F-092 section gained a 'Pygame sunset (US-402)' subsection (cut-over mechanism + the resolution-fix root cause) + the A-4 sequencing note updated to DONE + the older 'Two Display Surfaces' section banner-marked the Status overlay RETIRED. GATES (BENCH per validationMethod, TDD red->green): tests/pi/hardware/test_manager_status_display_disable.py +5 (TestPiNestedConfigResolution: nested-disable honored, init-skips-construction=no-pygame, nested-forceSoftwareRenderer, nested-precedes-flat, flat-back-compat-preserved) all green incl. the 7 pre-existing; tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit.py +1 (test_shippedConfig_retiresPygameStatusDisplay_f4 = config.json ships statusDisplay.enabled=false, the F-4 cut-over-artifact proof) = full file green; full tests/pi/hardware suite 0 regressions (4 platform skips); tests/pi/obdii/orchestrator green; python validate_config.py PASS; ruff clean on all touched .py. DEFERRED (Pi bench, per validationMethod): I-7 (systemctl/log check post-deploy -> pygame status_display not launched) = live check at sprint validation (not reproducible off-Pi). DEFERRED-PM SEQUENCING (honest-instrument flag): the US-400/401 emitter live call-site wiring (orchestrator/power emit(...) feeding real BT/sync/power/drive + MAX17048/health-log readings) was DEFERRED by US-400/401 to the Pi-bench integration. The emitter MECHANISM exists (republish path in place), so 'data republished via the emitters' is structurally satisfied; but until the live emit() call-sites land IN THE SAME Pi deploy window, the HTML cards will read `unavailable` (honest-instrument, no fabrication) rather than live data. The sprint deploys US-399..402 together (per US-399), so PM must fold the deferred US-400/401 emit wiring into the same Pi deploy so the cards aren't blank once pygame is gone. DEFERRED-PM: mypy (not on dev box; factory change is fully-hinted) + full `pytest tests/` (slow SMB; the scoped suites above are the in-iteration gate). stories.goal: As the operator, I want a deliberate, accident-proof menu to restart/stop services + exit the UI, without the kiosk running as root or letting me brick the safe-shutdown guard.
stories.completionNotes: System Setup menu + gated service control SHIPPED -- A-7 privilege path built as the net-new 51- polkit rule (NOT a helper daemon, NOT a widening of the I-036 50- poweroff rule) + a THREE-LAYER defense-in-depth (UI / action-path / polkit), each layer assuming the one above is compromised. PRIVILEGE MECHANISM: the chromium kiosk is unprivileged (HTTP-only) -- it POSTs /service-control {unit,verb} to the eclipse-states-http server (its only IPC), which runs as User=mcornelison + delegates to the new src/pi/splash/service_control.py (the allow-list SSOT) which shells `systemctl <verb> <unit>`; the 51-eclipse-service-control.rules polkit rule authorizes that call for mcornelison KEYED ON BOTH unit AND verb. NEW src/pi/splash/service_control.py: SERVICE_ALLOWLIST (install-fixed CODE constant, NOT config -- 'install-fixed' is a safety property; a runtime-editable list would let a kiosk compromise widen its reach) = eclipse-obd/eclipse-sync {start,stop,restart}, eclipse-dashboard {stop,restart} (A-8 Exit=stop kiosk), eclipse-powerwatch {restart} ONLY; isAllowed gate + runServiceAction(unit,verb,*,runner=subprocess.run) that RE-CHECKS isAllowed at the action path (defense-in-depth, the F-092 analog of US-407 S-10) -> off-list NEVER shells out; honest failure (non-zero systemctl -> ok=False w/ stderr, never fake success) + never-raises (timeout/OSError caught so the server thread can't crash). D-7/F-7 POWERWATCH RESTART-ONLY = the load-bearing invariant: a stop/kill is refused at ALL THREE layers -- the UI Stop button is disabled, runServiceAction rejects it, AND the polkit rule returns an EXPLICIT polkit.Result.NO (so a direct `systemctl stop eclipse-powerwatch` at the action path with the UI bypassed is still refused -- the A-7 defense-in-depth bench test). states_http_server.py: added do_POST for the SINGLE write route /service-control (token-gated like the reads; off-list->403 never executed; allowed->200 w/ honest {ok,returnCode,reason}; bad path->404; GET stays read-only). Win gotcha fixed: drain the POST body BEFORE responding or the connection resets (WinError 10053). carousel.js: pure node-testable api -- serviceMenuItems (powerwatch canStop:false), requiresConfirm (stop confirms, restart doesn't), actionRequest (UI allow-list mirror -> null off-list, mirrors service_control + polkit), longPressProgress/isLongPressComplete/exceedsMoveCancel (D-6 ~5s ring math, movement>10px cancels). DOM (browser-only, inside the document guard): ⋮ + long-press both open #setup-menu; ring (#longpress-ring, conic-gradient --fill) fills after a 600ms arm; Stop/Exit go through a confirm modal (F-6 no single consequential tap), Restart acts directly; powerwatch Stop rendered disabled (I-10/F-7); ✕/Back always present (never trapped); Exit = stop eclipse-dashboard (A-8) -> drops to desktop, returns on reboot via the splash OnSuccess hand-off (no [Install]); failures surface in the menu status line (no console logging, no fabrication). dashboard.html: #setup-menu overlay + #svc-list + #menu-exit + #menu-close + #confirm-modal + #longpress-ring. dashboard.css: menu/ring/confirm styles, .svc-btn:disabled visibly inert, >=40px tap targets on all menu buttons. deploy/polkit-rules/51-eclipse-service-control.rules: manage-units scoped to mcornelison, keyed on unit AND verb, powerwatch restart-only w/ explicit NO, obd/sync/dashboard start+stop+restart, default-deny otherwise. deploy-pi.sh: step_install_polkit_service_control (mirrors step_install_polkit_poweroff idempotent sync-if-changed) + wired right after step_install_polkit_poweroff. Rule-10: specs/architecture.md F-092 section gained a 'System Setup menu + gated service control (US-403)' subsection (3-layer privilege path, allow-list table, powerwatch restart-only invariant, Exit/Close lifecycle, eclipse-sync deploy-gap note). GATES (BENCH per validationMethod, TDD red->green): tests/pi/splash/test_service_control.py 23 (allow-list incl powerwatch stop/kill/start denied + off-list units/verbs; runServiceAction allowed-invokes / powerwatch-stop-rejected-never-executed / off-list-never-executed / honest-nonzero / never-raises); tests/pi/splash/test_states_http_service_control.py 6 (401 no-token / 403 off-list / 403 powerwatch-stop / 200 allowed-delegate / 404 bad-path / GET-read-only); tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit.py +6 (US-403 node logic: ring math + serviceMenuItems powerwatch-canStop-false + requiresConfirm + actionRequest off-list-null + exit-confirms; HTML setup-menu/ring/confirm/close; CSS menu/ring/disabled/tap-targets; polkit rule manage-units+user / unit+verb keying / powerwatch-restart-only-deny / obd+sync+dashboard granted; deploy-pi.sh installs the 51- rule) = full file 34 passed.
